Container.Name: Sonarr-Fork
Container.Overview: Sonarr fork with complete-series and multi-season pack support. Runs on port 8990 to avoid conflict with mainline Sonarr on 8989. Branch: feature/complete-series-pack-support.
Container.Description: Sonarr fork with complete-series and multi-season pack support. Runs on port 8990 to avoid conflict with mainline Sonarr on 8989. Branch: feature/complete-series-pack-support.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the Sonarr web interface. Mapped to container port 8989. Defaults to 8990 to avoid clashing with mainline Sonarr on 8989.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Sonarr configuration, database, and logs. Adjust before deploying if needed.

Config.Name: TV Library
Config.Description: TV series library. Adjust to your media share before deploying.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Download client completed folder. Adjust to your downloads share before deploying.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the container files are owned by. Match to your Unraid user (default 1000).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the container files are owned by. Match to your Unraid user (default 1000).
